skills.name: confluent-cloud-cdc-tableflow
skills.description: Set up end-to-end Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines on Confluent Cloud using Debezium source connectors, Flink for transformation, and Tableflow for data lake integration. Supports JSON_SR, Avro, and Protobuf formats. Handles schemaless topics (plain JSON without SR) and multi-event topics. This skill handles the complete workflow from database to Iceberg/Delta tables. Use this skill when users want to capture database changes and materialize them into Iceberg or Delta Lake tables via Confluent Cloud Tableflow. Trigger phrases include "CDC to Tableflow", "database to Iceberg", "database to Delta Lake", "stream database changes to data lake", "set up Tableflow pipeline", "schemaless topic to Tableflow", or "multi-event topic to Iceberg". Do NOT trigger for general CDC, Debezium, or database replication requests that do not involve Tableflow or Iceberg/Delta Lake as the destination.
headings: Confluent Cloud CDC to Tableflow Pipeline
Phase 0: Tool Selection & MCP Server Validation (CRITICAL)
skills.description_zh: 在 Confluent Cloud 上搭建数据库到 Iceberg／Delta Lake 的完整 CDC 流程，使用 Debezium 源连接器捕获变更、Flink 转换和 Tableflow 接入数据湖。支持 JSON_SR、Avro、Protobuf，以及无 Schema Registry 的普通 JSON 和多事件主题；适用于以 Tableflow 或 Iceberg／Delta Lake 为目标的链路。

skills.name: confluent-cloud-flink-sql
skills.description: Write and debug Flink SQL that runs on Confluent Cloud, enforcing the CC-vs-Apache-Flink (OSS) dialect boundary. Use when the working directory is a Confluent Cloud Flink workspace, when a Flink SQL statement needs checking before it runs on a CC compute pool, or when the user mentions CC Flink, Confluent Cloud Flink SQL, the `confluent flink` CLI, a CFU compute pool, `CREATE CONNECTION`, or asks to check or debug Flink SQL whose runtime is Confluent Cloud. Also trigger when a Flink SQL question is posed and nothing establishes an Apache Flink OSS runtime. Do NOT trigger for: building or deploying Flink UDFs in Java (UDF/UDTF/PTF — use flink-udf); a full CDC pipeline from a database through Flink into Tableflow/Iceberg/Delta Lake (use confluent-cloud-cdc-tableflow); Kafka Streams topology work (use kafka-streams-programming); or Flink SQL confirmed to run on Apache Flink OSS, not Confluent Cloud.
skills.description_zh: 编写和调试运行于 Confluent Cloud 的 Flink SQL，明确其与开源 Apache Flink 方言的边界，覆盖 CC 工作区、CFU 计算池、CREATE CONNECTION 和 confluent flink CLI。Java 自定义函数、完整 CDC 到 Tableflow 链路及 Kafka Streams 拓扑分别由对应技能处理；已确认的开源 Flink SQL 不在此范围。

skills.name: confluent-skill-creator
skills.description: Create Confluent-specific skills for external users. Use this skill when users want to create, build, or author a new skill related to Confluent Cloud, Confluent Platform, Apache Kafka, WarpStream, Flink, Connectors, Schema Registry, Tableflow, CDC pipelines, or any Confluent product. Skills can be use-case focused (like data enrichment, CDC to Tableflow, stream processing workflows) or component-specific (like a Flink skill, Schema Registry skill, or Connector skill). Do NOT use this skill when users want to directly use Confluent products (e.g., build a pipeline, write a producer, deploy Flink SQL) — use the appropriate product-specific skill instead. This skill is specifically for creating new skills, not for using existing ones.
headings: Progressive disclosure — a three-level loading system
Step 1: Understand Scope and Platform Targeting
Step 2-3: Capture Intent and Write Skill
skills.description_zh: 为外部用户创建 Confluent 专用技能，范围包括 Confluent Cloud／Platform、Kafka、WarpStream、Flink、连接器、Schema Registry、Tableflow 和 CDC。可按数据富化等用例或产品组件组织；适用于编写新技能，实际产品操作由产品技能处理。

skills.name: confluent-skill-reviewer
skills.description: Review a Confluent agent skill in this repo against the Agent Skills spec (agentskills.io), Confluent conventions in CLAUDE.md, the PR template gates, and the evals-as-contract rule. Use this skill whenever the user asks to review, audit, validate, or lint a skill; opens or inspects a PR that adds or modifies anything under `skills/`; asks about spec conformance, lazy-loading, frontmatter shape, trigger overlap, or eval coverage; or wants a pre-merge sanity check on skill changes. Do NOT trigger for general code review of application code; security review; auditing schemas, producer/consumer configs, PII tagging, or Terraform generation for Schema Registry (handled by `kafka-schema-registry`); runtime/log analysis of skill behavior (use `tools/skill_review_dashboard.py`); or any changes that don't touch the `skills/` tree.
headings: confluent-skill-reviewer — audit a Confluent agent skill
Phase E — PR template gates (PR-diff mode only)
Skill review: <skill name or PR title>
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 按 Agent Skills 规范、仓库 CLAUDE.md 中的 Confluent 约定、PR 门槛和评估契约规则审查 skills/ 下的技能变更。检查前置元数据、按需加载、触发重叠及评估覆盖，适用于技能审计和合并前检查；应用代码、安全、Schema Registry 和运行日志分析另有工具。

skills.name: Bad_Frontmatter
skills.description_zh: 技能审查评估中的错误前置元数据模拟样例。原描述仅称“帮助处理事情”，没有明确业务用途；应作为测试材料理解。

skills.name: good-skill
skills.description: Generate a Confluent Cloud topic creation script with idempotency checks. Use when the user asks to create a topic, provision topics, or write a `create-topics.sh` for Confluent Cloud. Do NOT trigger for self-managed Apache Kafka, schema registration, Terraform generation, or Kafka Streams topology authoring.
skills.description_zh: 技能审查评估中的合格模拟样例：生成带幂等检查的 Confluent Cloud 主题创建脚本，适用于主题配置和 create-topics.sh 编写。其描述排除自管 Kafka、模式注册、Terraform 和 Kafka Streams 拓扑。

skills.name: inlined-refs
skills.description: Generate a Kafka consumer group lag dashboard. Use when the user asks to monitor lag, build a dashboard for consumer lag, or wire up Prometheus exporters for Kafka. Do NOT trigger for producer metrics, broker JMX, or Streams-specific monitoring.
skills.description_zh: 技能审查评估中的引用内联模拟样例：生成 Kafka 消费组延迟仪表板，用于延迟监测和 Prometheus exporter 接入。其描述排除生产者指标、broker JMX 及 Streams 专用监控。

skills.name: leaky-data
skills.description: Enrich a customer-orders stream with loyalty tier using Flink SQL on Confluent Cloud. Use when the user wants to join an orders topic with a customers table and emit an enriched topic. Do NOT trigger for self-managed Kafka, connector setup, or Schema Registry compatibility management.
headings: leaky-data — order enrichment (INTENTIONALLY LEAKY TEST FIXTURE)
skills.description_zh: 技能审查评估中的数据泄漏模拟样例：用 Confluent Cloud Flink SQL 将订单主题与客户表关联，加入会员等级并输出富化主题。其描述排除自管 Kafka、连接器配置和 Schema Registry 兼容性管理。

skills.name: stale-expectations
skills.description: Generate a Schema Registry compatibility report for Avro schemas in a project. Use when the user asks to check Avro compatibility, validate schema evolution, or report breaking changes. Do NOT trigger for Protobuf, JSON Schema, or Kafka client code generation.
skills.description_zh: 技能审查评估中的预期过时模拟样例：为项目内 Avro 模式生成 Schema Registry 兼容性报告，检查模式演化和破坏性变更。其描述排除 Protobuf、JSON Schema 和 Kafka 客户端代码生成。

skills.name: trigger-overlap
skills.description: Build a Confluent Cloud topic provisioning script with retention and compaction. Use when the user asks to create a topic, write a `create-topics.sh`, set retention, set compaction policy, provision topics for Confluent Cloud, or generate idempotent topic scripts.
skills.description_zh: 技能审查评估中的触发重叠模拟样例：生成 Confluent Cloud 主题配置脚本，涵盖保留时间、日志压缩策略和幂等主题创建。应作为技能触发测试材料理解。

skills.name: confluent-tuning-advisor
skills.description: Advisory-only Kafka tuning for Confluent Cloud or Confluent Platform by priority: latency, throughput, availability, or durability. Use when asked to size a planned topic or tune an existing cluster, topic, producer, or consumer for a quantified target such as lower p99 latency or no lost acknowledged writes. Inspects configuration read-only and recommends changes, trade-offs, and validation; the administrator applies them. Do NOT trigger for: WarpStream or Apache Kafka OSS-only clusters; Flink SQL or UDF authoring, tuning, or debugging (use confluent-cloud-flink-sql or flink-udf); Kafka Connect tuning; new Java/Python client implementation (use developing-kafka-java-client or developing-kafka-python-client); Kafka Streams/KStream/KTable development (use kafka-streams-programming); or CDC, Tableflow, or Iceberg pipelines (use confluent-cloud-cdc-tableflow).
headings: Step 1: Capture the workload and priority
Step 3: Inspect the current config as a baseline (read-only)
Step 6: Hand off for execution (the administrator applies, not this skill)
Step 7: Give the administrator validation steps
skills.description_zh: 只读检查 Confluent Cloud／Platform 的 Kafka 配置，按延迟、吞吐、可用性或持久性目标提供调优建议、权衡及验证方案，由管理员实施。适用于主题容量规划及集群、主题、生产者、消费者调优；排除 WarpStream、纯开源 Kafka、Flink、Connect、客户端开发、Streams 和 CDC／Tableflow 链路。

skills.name: developing-kafka-java-client
skills.description: Use when the user wants to integrate a Kafka client into an existing application or scaffold a Java Kafka client project (Maven or Gradle based) for Confluent Cloud, local Docker, or WarpStream. Covers the Apache Kafka Java clients (KafkaProducer/KafkaConsumer/KafkaShareConsumer) with Avro, JSON Schema, or Protobuf serializers. Also use when the user wants to optimize Java Kafka client configuration for WarpStream. Do NOT trigger for Kafka Streams apps (use kafka-streams-programming), Flink, connectors, or Kafka Python client (use developing-kafka-python-client).
headings: If your WarpStream deployment requires SASL auth, uncomment:
If using Confluent Cloud Schema Registry, uncomment:
skills.description_zh: 将 Kafka Java 客户端集成进现有应用，或搭建 Maven／Gradle 客户端项目，适配 Confluent Cloud、本地 Docker 和 WarpStream。涵盖 KafkaProducer、KafkaConsumer、KafkaShareConsumer 及 Avro、JSON Schema、Protobuf 序列化器，也支持 WarpStream 客户端配置优化；Streams、Flink、连接器及 Python 客户端由其他技能处理。

skills.name: developing-kafka-python-client
skills.description: Use when the user wants to build a Python Kafka producer or consumer, add Schema Registry to existing Python code, migrate from raw JSON to schema-backed serialization, or scaffold a confluent-kafka-python project for Confluent Cloud, local Docker, or WarpStream. Also use when user wants to optimize Python Kafka client configuration for WarpStream.
headings: Schema ID in Headers vs Wire Format
If your WarpStream deployment requires SASL auth, uncomment:
skills.description_zh: 开发 Python Kafka 生产者或消费者，为现有代码接入 Schema Registry，迁移普通 JSON 至基于模式的序列化，或搭建适配 Confluent Cloud、本地 Docker 和 WarpStream 的 confluent-kafka-python 项目；也支持 WarpStream 客户端配置优化。

skills.name: flink-udf
skills.description: Build and deploy Apache Flink user-defined functions (UDFs) in Java for stream processing over Kafka. Use this skill when users want to create scalar UDFs, user-defined table functions (UDTFs), or process table functions (PTFs) in Java, deploy them to Confluent Cloud or local Docker environments, and invoke them from Flink SQL or the Table API. Trigger on: Flink UDF, custom Flink function, process table function, PTF, UDTF, Flink user defined, extend Flink SQL, stateful stream processing with Flink. Do NOT trigger for: Kafka Streams UDFs (use kafka-streams-programming skill), general Flink job development without custom functions, CDC streaming data piplines that include Flink (prefer the confluent-cloud-cdc-tableflow skill), Flink connector setup, or Kafka producer/consumer code.
skills.description_zh: 用 Java 构建和部署 Apache Flink 标量 UDF、表函数 UDTF 或处理表函数 PTF，适配 Confluent Cloud 与本地 Docker，并从 Flink SQL 或 Table API 调用。适用于自定义函数和有状态流处理扩展；Kafka Streams、无自定义函数的一般 Flink 作业、连接器、客户端代码及完整 CDC 链路由其他技能处理。

skills.name: kafka-schema-registry
skills.description: Scan a project to identify Kafka applications, extract schemas from data models, tag PII fields, generate Terraform for Confluent Schema Registry registration, and produce a migration report with rollout ordering. Use this skill when a user asks to analyze a folder or repo for Kafka usage, extract schemas, audit producer/consumer configurations, or generate Terraform for Schema Registry.
skills.description_zh: 扫描项目以识别 Kafka 应用，从数据模型提取模式并标记个人身份信息字段，生成 Confluent Schema Registry 注册所需的 Terraform，以及含上线顺序的迁移报告。适用于仓库 Kafka 使用分析、模式提取和生产者／消费者配置审计。

skills.name: kafka-streams-programming
skills.description: Architect, build, and debug Kafka Streams apps (JVM-embedded stream processing). Use when user mentions KStream, KTable, topology, TopologyTestDriver, StreamsBuilder, interactive queries, GlobalKTable, joins/windows/aggregations, or debugging issues (rebalancing, state stores, lag, deserialization errors). Also use when user wants to optimize Kafka Streams for WarpStream or tune Kafka Streams client configuration for WarpStream. Do NOT trigger for Flink, connectors, CDC, or plain producer/consumer.
headings: Step 6: Run the App Before Handing Off
skills.description_zh: 设计、开发和调试嵌入 JVM 的 Kafka Streams 应用，覆盖 KStream、KTable、拓扑、TopologyTestDriver、交互查询、GlobalKTable、关联、窗口和聚合，以及重平衡、状态存储、延迟和反序列化问题。也支持 WarpStream 配置优化；Flink、连接器、CDC 和普通生产者／消费者另行处理。

skills.name: msk-migration
skills.description: Use this skill to assess and plan a migration from AWS MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka) to Confluent Cloud. Triggers on user intent like "migrate MSK to Confluent Cloud", "move off MSK", "MSK to CC cutover", "Zero-Cut migration from MSK", "kcp scan my MSK", or any discussion of MSK-to-CC assessment, planning, cluster sizing, Cluster Linking setup, Gateway-based switchover, or post-cutover validation. Do NOT trigger for non-MSK Kafka sources (open-source Kafka, Aiven, Confluent Platform, Redpanda) — this skill is MSK-only. Do NOT trigger for greenfield Confluent Cloud projects with no existing Kafka source. Do NOT trigger for general Kafka programming questions (producer/consumer code, Kafka Streams) unrelated to migration.
headings: AWS MSK Migration to Confluent Cloud
Cluster type: default to Enterprise, escalate to Dedicated only on hard limits
skills.description_zh: 评估和规划 AWS MSK 到 Confluent Cloud 的迁移，涵盖扫描、集群容量、Cluster Linking、基于 Gateway 的切换、Zero-Cut 迁移及切换后验证。仅面向已有 MSK 来源的迁移，不适用于其他 Kafka 来源、全新 Cloud 项目或无迁移关联的客户端编程。
